steps.content:
The FAC's internal threat has been largely eliminated. The Underground's intelligence on us has significantly decreased. The time has come. The BR-002 Black Ring Blockade Operation is fully underway.


The FAC will shift its focus back to the main battlefield, dealing with all possible obstacles.

The 9th Agency is keeping a close eye on the actions of suspicious elements from the Underground. The Black Ring Blockade Operation will inevitably be fiercely countered by the enemy. This is also an opportunity to tear off their disguise.

Paradeisos's HUSH Unit will withdraw from the main battlefield and continue to investigate the mastermind behind the attack from the Garden. This relates to the spatial mysteries of the hidden Underground entrance.

Paradeisos's special envoy Hush X will continue to assist in operations, providing observational data and strategies for reference.

0:00 a.m., August 19th, N.F. 113
FAC Black Ring Blockade Operation Joint Command

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: The amount of observational data that X obtained is too large. The research institute has only analyzed a part of it, and the progress is slow. But... the results are shocking.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: BR-002's mass has far exceeded expectations, and is rapidly expanding inward. It's already the largest Secondary Black Ring in history, and its depth is unimaginable.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Nirvana has urgently added operational funding support and assured the Executive Committee's active cooperation with the FAC to suppress BR-002. This is good news.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: How to suppress it? The state of BR-002 is different from that of any Black Ring in the past. Right now, we can only suppress the contamination overflow from it. We also have to strictly guard against the Underground. Their Shepherd won't turn a blind eye to this huge Black Ring.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: ...
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Don't we also have our own <color=#fb9259>Shepherd</color>?

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Do you mean <color=#fb9259>SHP-13</color>, who disappeared four months ago, Shackles-${PlayerName}?

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The observational data from X is quite clear. At least we can confirm that he's still alive. The "shackles" are connected to BR-002, and the connection is getting tighter.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: No matter how powerful the Underground's Shepherd is, as long as Paradeisos finds SHP-13 first, humanity will take the lead.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: While contacting the BR-002 Corpus, the defensive <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> inside his body have activated twice to halt his swallowing process. This shows that the risk is already close to surpassing our limit.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Now that he's connected with the BR-002 Corpus, and further connected with the rapidly expanding mega-Black Ring, the immense Mania has dissolved all the safeguards we've set. In my opinion, he should not be trusted.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Even if he's the weakest defective product, he's still way beyond our control. Plus, before...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: It's okay, <color=#fb9259>X</color> will find him.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: If our safety measures falter, just reinforce them. Eliminate any unexpected risky behavior on the spot.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Paradeisos's <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> are ironclad for them; we've verified this. The moment he regains control, Mania won't be able to dismantle the "Rules" we've established. He's a valuable asset.

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: There's a high chance SHP-13 is trapped in the Depths of Mania. Locate him but don't awaken him; keep him in that state.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Have the Underground Shepherd consume BR-002 Corpus, which will also result in the consumption of SHP-13. FAC's defense grid will pinpoint the moment when the three entities are ready to fuse, and then...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Take this chance to apply the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> to SHP-13. If we can't wipe out all three threats at once, we can at least severely cripple the Underground Shepherd. Marking it alone would be a win for us.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Isn't that right, <color=#fb9259>X</color>?

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: When handled correctly, even hazardous materials can become indispensable tools.

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Apologies, a stray kitten wandered in. I've just shooed it away. I'll get right on reviewing the logs.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: You seem to be holding up well.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Yes, you know me well. The plan is going smoothly, and I find that gratifying.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: So, besides giving direct support to FAC, my real job is to recover <color=#fb9259>SHP-13</color>, correct?

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Exactly.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Excellent. I've already considered this scenario and have a plan in place. Coincidentally, it ties in with what I'm working on right now...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The Garden?

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Correct. They're targeting me, and since I can't evade them, I'll turn them into an asset.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Otherwise, once the Underground gets wind of it and sends them after ${PlayerName}, we may not outpace those assassins.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: You're always so dependable. This is a difficult task. Would you like to extend your service life?

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: No, risk management comes first.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: I've been <color=#fb9259>observing</color> for far too long; the corrosive risk is approaching the limit. The operation should be handed off when the time is right.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: The war is about to begin. We should let a more reliable backup take control of the HUSH system to ensure uninterrupted strategy.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Don't worry, all your needs will be taken care of, just like always.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Very well.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: You've always been our most efficient and dependable Hush; you've never let us down.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Of course, it's already underway; it'll be very soon...

Once the communication is over, Shalom takes the damp cloth from Rahu and wipes away the grime that has splashed onto her. Another Mania assassin has just been dealt with, the monocular mark on its face slowly fading away.

As its body breaks apart, eerie fragments are revealed. Every puppet that has attacked her over the past half-month has carried similar objects. Shalom compiles the encoded messages; even though they're incomplete, it's enough to discern the sender's motives. She allows herself a subtle smile.
